messages:
ana: Quick thread to align on 'minimal GA' for private deploys (VPC/on-prem). Need clear ship gates for networking + upgrades. Thoughts?

claire: Keep GA narrow. Must guarantee an upgrade path that doesn't change customer-facing IPs and provide a short peering handoff runbook.

devon: Technical: we'll support two networking patterns GA: cloud peering (preferred) and customer BGP. Relay/agent-mediated connections are tech-preview only.

mike: From runtime: add an operator upgrade hook so control-plane can canary, wait for KV warm, then roll data-plane. Also require a post-upgrade validation script customers can run.

sara: Field needs: a 10-minute checklist the customer can give netops, and an email template for scheduling a maintenance window. Netops often gives <2h.

priya: Security gating: signed installer artefacts, BYO-KMS integration patterns, and least-privilege IAM templates for peering. Also document audit-log routing to customer SIEMs.

ana: (typo) ana: Add: offline install path for airgapped customers (signed tarball + verification steps).

devon: I'll own signed artifact pipeline + example manifest. Will include checksum and signature verification steps.

mike: I'll build an IP-preservation test harness that asserts external IPs unchanged across upgrades and produce the validation script (kubectl-based).

sara: I'll draft the support playbook and the quickstart one-pager. Will include a 'when to escalate to engineering' checklist.

claire: Draft launch gates:
- Signed installer + offline tarball validated in 2 distros
- IP continuity validated in at least 2 cloud providers and on-prem scenario
- Peering quickstart + IAM templates published
- BYO-KMS doc and audit log integration guide
- Customer-run smoke test template and support playbook
If any gate fails -> limited GA with field enablement only.

ops-bot: Created ticket RDW-PL-5001 "Private deploy: minimal GA networking gates" assigned @devon @mike @sara ETA 8bd.

claire: Ok team — please drop initial drafts in /docs/private and ping here. Reconvene next Tue for sign-off. :thumbsup:
